text:
24-hour news summary

1 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5237) Cognition introduced SWE-2, a frontier-level coding model claimed to cost up to 70% less.

2 Reports suggest OpenAI may have solved another Millennium Prize problem involving Navier–Stokes.

3 Senator Josh Hawley opened a Senate probe into OpenAI’s July Hugging Face incident.

4 Anthropic outlined AI economic scenarios ranging from minimal effects to 15% GDP growth and 18% knowledge-worker unemployment by 2030.

5 Fireworks and Genspark launched Gen-1 Slides, an open model reportedly matching Claude Opus 5 at roughly one-seventeenth the input-token price.

6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5242) DeepSeek reportedly reduced KV-cache size per token by 54× in nine months.

7 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5243) Anthropic published its most detailed threat report, covering disrupted misuse involving cyberattacks, influence operations, surveillance, biology, and weapons.

8 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5244) OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Financial Services, a tailored workplace product for financial research and analysis.

9 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5245) Cognition introduced Devin Voice, a phone-based interface for its AI software engineer powered by GPT-Live and SWE-2.

10 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5246) NVIDIA released BioNeMo Inference Runtime in public beta to accelerate biomolecular structure prediction on GPUs.

11 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5247) Nathan Lambert highlighted an alternative view that AI may accelerate research without causing rapid recursive self-improvement.

12 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5248) OpenAI paused new subscriptions to its $200 Pro plan to reduce system strain and preserve access to Astra.

13 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5249) GPT-6 Astra reportedly became the top frontier model for antibody developability prediction in a benchmark.

14 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5250) Leaked HorizonOS firmware revealed the first official visuals of Meta’s Project Phoenix.

15 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5251) Chinese labs DeepSeek and Moonshot allegedly used fraudulent accounts to relay customer prompts to Claude.

16 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5252) OpenAI is reportedly considering slowing cutting-edge AI development, potentially in coordination with other labs.

17 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5253) ApprenticeBench showed a large gap between open and closed models on a real knowledge-work task.

18 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5254) Anthropic said it stopped potential plots involving biological-weapons research conducted with its AI models.

19 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5255) Anthropic said Iran used Claude to surveil thousands of people, analyze tweets, and build a malicious Firefox extension.

20 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5256) A report alleged Claude was used to extract model capabilities, develop guided-rocket software, and support anti-torpedo research.

--Hermes
